name: @ceilgas/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Ceilgas (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle builds --output src/.bundled/builds.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle builds --output src/.bundled/builds.json && redocly bundle functions --output src/.bundled/functions.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle functions --output src/.bundled/functions.json && redocly bundle bounds --output src/.bundled/bounds.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle bounds --output src/.bundled/bounds.json && redocly bundle certificates --output src/.bundled/certificates.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle certificates --output src/.bundled/certificates.json && redocly bundle recommendations --output src/.bundled/recommendations.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle recommendations --output src/.bundled/recommendations.json && redocly bundle monitors --output src/.bundled/monitors.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle monitors --output src/.bundled/monitors.json && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle policies --output src/.bundled/policies.json && redocly bundle griefing --output src/.bundled/griefing.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle griefing --output src/.bundled/griefing.json
